review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines a Prop-valued class, two noncomputable IsColimit-valued definitions, and several instances and lemmas. None of these is a function with separate preservation or inverse lemmas, so none has a missing standard bundled interface such as a LinearMap, RingHom or equivalence. The only plain function is the local `f : Set.Iio m → Set.Iio m.1` inside `restriction_setIci`. It is paired with `Monotone f` and then passed through `Monotone.functor`. Bundling it as an `OrderHom` would add no API, because the proof immediately needs the functor from `hf.functor`, and the finding would be speculative. I did not run any search of the other source roots, so I can't rule out other existing bundled forms beyond what the file itself shows.
